decision.previous_status: m_csa:737 was blocked because beta-lysine 5,6-aminomutase uses coupled PLP and adenosylcobalamin chemistry that does not fit a plain cobalamin_radical_rearrangement label under the current 8-fingerprint universe.
decision.proposed_family_scope: Aminomutase or related rearrangement chemistry where PLP substrate aldimine chemistry and adenosylcobalamin radical chemistry are both mechanistically required in one catalytic cycle.

rejected_current_options.reason: would erase the required PLP transaldimination/substrate-imine axis and over-broaden the current cobalamin fingerprint
would erase the required adenosylcobalamin radical rearrangement axis
the current label registry and gates are built around one production fingerprint per seed-fingerprint label; multi-target counting would need a separate schema and leakage/benchmark audit

future_gate_requirements: draft ontology and fingerprint specification for coupled PLP-adenosylcobalamin aminomutase chemistry
independent positive exemplars beyond m_csa:737 before threshold or production scoring
external hard-negative and current-reference re-audit under the expanded universe
production scorer implementation and unit tests if the family is promoted beyond review-only
dedicated label-factory gate and batch acceptance for any eligible rows
decision.next_blocker_class: none in the specified 9-row M-CSA follow-up; do not repeat without new evidence or an explicit schema/fingerprint task

row.schema_issue: Current production fingerprints represent PLP-dependent enzymes and cobalamin radical rearrangements separately, but this row requires a coupled PLP plus adenosylcobalamin aminomutase family to avoid misleading single-fingerprint counting.
row.exact_blocker: No production coupled-cofactor family, multi-target label schema, scorer, controls, or dedicated gates exist in the current 8-fingerprint universe.
row.future_reopen_condition: explicit future schema/fingerprint task that starts from the review-only coupled-family proposal and satisfies the listed future gates
